name: compass
description: Adaptive spec-driven development for quick starts, fixes, uncertain ideas, and milestone delivery with independently validated tests and verified outcomes.

interface.longDescription: Compass helps developers turn an idea or bug report into clear requirements, an implementation plan, scoped changes, and verification evidence. Start with comp-engineer or choose one of nine skills for planning, analysis, implementation, review, delivery, and archiving. It uses the tools and conventions of your coding agent and repository. Behavior-changing implementation requires fresh subagents and independent test validation; agents without these capabilities can still plan and review. Compass does not provide an MCP server or hosted execution service.
defaultPrompt: Plan and implement a small feature in this repository.
Investigate this bug and verify the fix.
Review these changes against the agreed requirements.
